purpose: Persistent engineering notebook and checkpoint index for the ADV_Elite Beacon reconstruction so architectural decisions, source lineage, failures, tests and corrections are not lost across long contexts.

frozen_mission.canonical_summary_ru: ADV_Elite — автономный и переносной узел JANUS, одновременно являющийся частью умного дома. Он общается со swarm двусторонне, учится на реальных метриках физических датчиков и логах swarm, строит прогноз следующего состояния окружения и должен со временем уменьшать ошибку прогноза.
frozen_mission.strict_interpretation: Упорядочивание хаоса означает снижение проверяемой ошибки предсказания на будущих реальных данных; метафора не является физическим или научным утверждением сама по себе.

m2r_definition.origin: Calculator-style mathematical kernel repurposed as a generic forward simulator/world model, not as a weapon-control path.

janus_tachyon_semantics.tachyon: JANUS architecture/persona metaphor for a system that tries to stay ahead of observed state by forecasting future states.
janus_tachyon_semantics.atomic_clock: Authoritative disciplined time axis aligning observation, prediction horizon, realized future, replay, and prediction error.
janus_tachyon_semantics.epistemic_guard: No literal faster-than-light behavior or physical time-dilation claim follows from the Tachyon metaphor.

input: real current and historical sensor state
known deterministic or empirical physical relations
feedback: wait for matching real future timestamp
persist prediction and outcome in Witness

relationship_to_ai.predictive_ai: learned residual model, fusion layer, scenario scorer and pattern learner
relationship_to_ai.tachyon: temporal prediction/memory layer using the authoritative time axis
relationship_to_ai.witness: records what was predicted, when, from which inputs/model version, and what actually happened

compute_strategy.edge: bounded ensembles or reduced-order simulation on ESP32-class hardware
compute_strategy.habitat: heavier Monte Carlo/replay/calibration/model fitting on NAS/PC
compute_strategy.note: Future-cloud size is profiled and budgeted; no unverified throughput number is treated as fact.

adaptive_temporal_resolution.role: Sampling density and horizon may adapt to uncertainty/error, but this is subordinate to M2R's world-model role.

accepted_architecture_donor.source: raw TacticalAI Python prototype supplied by user
accepted_patterns: local student vs heavy teacher model

entries.why: User defined ADV_Elite as A+B+C and clarified the central goal as a self-learning predictive AI that exchanges data with the swarm and learns from real sensor and swarm logs.
entries.rollback: decision remains editable only by explicit user revision

entries.why: User clarified M2R as a generic forward world-model kernel derived from calculator-style physics, while Tachyon uses a strict time reference to distinguish now, forecast, and realized future.
entries.test: future implementation must compare forecast distributions with time-aligned real observations
entries.result: M2R frozen as world-model kernel; adaptive temporal resolution demoted to subfunction
entries.failure: previous Q02 framing was too narrow
